facts.fact: 祖母昏着，Jingling 和 Hoi 勉强把「箭号」撑住不沉。
facts.anchor: Por Por was out cold, Jingling and Hoi barely able to keep The Arrow afloat.

facts.fact: 符上的字起了作用，可鸡血撑不住这么大的门户。
facts.anchor: But chicken’s blood was not strong enough for a gateway as gargantuan as this.

facts.fact: 他僵在碎镜前，眼里的红蓝乱闪，像随时会换边。
facts.anchor: His eyes flickered erratically. Red and blue.

facts.fact: 她一手按着断肋，气若游丝地叫他。
facts.anchor: “Archie,” she wheezed, one hand on her broken ribs.

facts.fact: 那层黑毛在风里散掉，只剩人留在原地。
facts.anchor: The dark pelt dissipating in the wind like it was nothing more than a shadow her own fears had conjured on the darkest night

facts.fact: 她求他帮自己把这事了结。
facts.anchor: “Help me end this, Archie.”

facts.fact: 他说他们做了不少好事：有工做、有钱买饭、有学校。
facts.anchor: “But look how much good we’ve done. There’s prosperity here: people have jobs, money to put food on the table, schools.”

facts.fact: 她顶回去：香港街头有妖在杀人。
facts.anchor: “There are monsters stalking the streets of Hong Kong. Killing people right now.

facts.fact: 他把死人叫作可以接受的损失，说最后总会值得。
facts.anchor: “Acceptable losses, but in the end it will be worth it. You’ll see.”

facts.fact: 他信帝国会护着他们，一向如此。
facts.anchor: “Don’t worry, the Empire will protect us. It always has.”

facts.fact: 他叫她别去想，不想就不会疼。
facts.anchor: “Just don’t think about it, Kiamling. If you don’t think, it cannot hurt you.

facts.fact: 她说了爱他，还有许多话没说出来。
facts.anchor: “I love you,” she said. There were more words left unsaid.

facts.fact: 那三个英文字在粤语里也只是三个字，不够用。
facts.anchor: Those three words in English were still three words in Cantonese.

facts.fact: 他说对不起，把 Lancaster 的枪顶在她肋上。
facts.anchor: “I’m sorry.” He pressed a pistol against her ribcage. Lancaster’s gun

facts.fact: 她往后退，枪跟着她，像一枚贴身的吻。
facts.anchor: The gun followed her, glued to her body like a kiss.

facts.fact: 他说但愿不必走到这一步，然后扣下扳机。
facts.anchor: “I wish it didn’t have to be this way.” He pulled the trigger.

facts.fact: 空膛转了几下，只响出空响——他根本没查过弹仓。
facts.anchor: The empty barrel revolved in the chamber. Click. Click. Click.

facts.fact: 她把铜钱剑捅进他腹部，直没到柄。
facts.anchor: She thrust the coin sword up through his abdomen, all the way to the hilt.

facts.fact: 他求她替他向母亲说一声对不起。
facts.anchor: “Tell my mother… will you tell her I’m sorry?”

facts.fact: 他说自己想起来了：他们的每一次吻。
facts.anchor: “Our kisses. Every… single one.”

facts.fact: 猎妖人都知道狗血比鸡血厉害，她拿黑狗血重写帆布上的符。
facts.anchor: Every yiugwai hunter knew that the blood of a dog was more potent than that of a chicken.

facts.fact: 祖母戳她的断肋，问她是不是在想什么蠢到极点的事。
facts.anchor: “Au Kiamling, you aren’t contemplating something monumentally stupid right now?”

facts.fact: 船已漂近九龙，裂口合上，夜里又静了。
facts.anchor: The ship had drifted closer to Kowloon.

facts.fact: Hoi 要她到了广州请他喝最好的茅台。
facts.anchor: “When we get there, you’re buying me the finest mau toi you can afford.”
